source_snapshot.procedure: Run `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x36` on localhost and the same raw request over lanplus from a remote client.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should have no error, followed by copied reset checks for BMC alive after reset, unchanged MAC/IP, non-default SEL time and unaffected system power even though no reset exists in Procedure.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL incorrectly says exact request bytes are missing although the row supplies 0x06/0x36, but correctly requests response acceptance.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE correctly preserves the read and separates BT capability acceptance from irrelevant reset criteria, but leaves the standard five-byte field schema as a Project/vendor input.

old_problem: The historical record retained Pending and Source Conflict because the source's primary Criteria are copied from a reset case and the response fields were treated as firmware-specific. IPMI v2.0 section 22.10 fully defines no-data App 0x36 and its five response data bytes. The command is read-only and mandatory when a BT system interface is used; target/interface binding is a runtime prerequisite rather than an engineering decision.
disposition_reason: Preserve both explicit localhost IB and remote OOB reads and this IB identity. First prove the local device really uses the BT system interface and both paths bind the same BMC/firmware. Run standard 0x06/0x36 once per path, require successful completion and exactly five data bytes, decode every standard field, enforce legal ranges and compare the normalized results. Treat the copied reset statements only as no-side-effect regression observations; never issue a reset, clear logs, expose credentials or retry automatically.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1010, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1011 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1011 / variant 8a21affe0b168fcf.

IPMI v2.0 section 22.10 and Table 22-13 define App command 0x36 with no request data and exactly five response data fields after completion: outstanding requests, input buffer size, output buffer size, request-to-response seconds and recommended retries.

Outstanding requests is 1-based with zero illegal; buffer sizes are 1-based; request-to-response time is 1-based with 30 seconds maximum. The length byte itself is not included in the reported buffer message sizes.

Sections 11.1 through 11.4 define BT multithreaded Seq matching, response expiration and the role of the advertised timing/retry values. They do not authorize this review runner to retry a failed DUT query automatically.

Table 22-1 makes Get BT Interface Capabilities mandatory only when BT is used. Therefore a generic localhost `/dev/ipmi` path must be proven as BT, and non-BT platforms may be N/A only with authoritative interface evidence per ED-13.

ED-02, ED-03, ED-13, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-22 and ED-28 preserve both transport observations, field-level evidence and source identity; ED-33 through ED-38 permit correcting copied criteria while prohibiting log clear, hidden mutation or retry.

test_case.test_name: Read and decode BT interface capabilities through verified in-band BT and same-BMC OOB paths
test_case.purpose: Verify the intended BMC exposes a standards-conformant BT interface capability record through the actual local BT path and the source-required protected OOB correlation path, with identical normalized capabilities and no reset, network, time, power or log mutation.
required_package: Immutable DUT/host/BMC mapping, firmware identity and authoritative ACPI/device-tree/kernel evidence that the selected local IPMI device is BT rather than KCS, SMIC or SSIF
Pinned ipmitool build and versioned App 0x36 parser separating tool/transport/IPMI completion from exactly five returned data bytes
Secret-safe remote lanplus wrapper using protected credential injection, pinned cipher/policy and same-BMC identity verification; no password argument or host-key bypass
Standard legality rules plus any Project-approved exact capability profile; absence of an exact profile does not relax standard framing/range/parity checks
Evidence store for raw IB/OOB bytes, decoded values, interface proof, unchanged health baselines and a no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY AUTOMATION ONLY; DO NOT RUN DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact host, BMC and local IPMI device and prove its system-interface type is BT. If authoritative platform evidence proves BT is absent, record SPEC-backed N/A; do not infer N/A from a command error. Preserve logs and capture BMC identity/firmware, MAC/IP, SEL clock sanity and host power as no-side-effect baselines. Execute the pinned equivalent of `ipmitool -I open -d <verified-bt-device> raw 0x06 0x36` once with a bounded timeout. Separately execute the source-required same-BMC protected OOB equivalent of `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC_IP> -U <BMC_USER> -E raw 0x06 0x36` once, with secrets excluded from argv/logs. For each path require successful transport/IPMI completion and exactly five data bytes: outstanding requests must be nonzero; input/output sizes must be nonzero; response time must be 1..30 seconds; decode recommended retries as the reported standard value and flag zero or any vendor divergence for explicit reference review rather than guessing. Compare all five normalized bytes across IB/OOB and to any approved exact Project profile. Recheck identity, MAC/IP, SEL clock and power only to prove no unintended change. Do not clear logs, reset BMC, change network/time/power, invoke the advertised retry count, or retry this query automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Both verified paths reach the same BMC/firmware, complete 0x36 without error, return exactly the same five-byte BT capability record and decode into legal standard fields. The local request is proven to traverse BT. No BMC reset occurs and BMC reachability/identity, MAC/IP, SEL clock, host power and preserved logs remain unchanged. A SPEC-proven non-BT platform is N/A, not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact identity, positive BT-interface proof, one IB and one protected OOB request, successful transport and IPMI completion, exactly five data bytes per response, nonzero outstanding/input/output values, response time 1..30, reviewed retries encoding, byte-for-byte normalized parity and any supplied Project-profile match. Command exit success alone, only one path, KCS/SSIF masquerading as IB BT, wrong length, zero/illegal/unknown field, divergent paths, target mismatch, credential exposure, log clear or any reset/network/time/power side effect cannot pass. Missing binding/profile is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending; non-BT is N/A only with SPEC proof.
safety_gate: Allow only read-only App NetFn 0x06 command 0x36 on the two verified paths; deny reset, power, network, time, configuration and arbitrary raw commands.
Prove the localhost device is an actual BT system interface before claiming `(IB)` BT coverage; generic in-band reachability through another interface is not equivalent.
Bind OOB to the same physical BMC/firmware and inject secrets through the approved protected mechanism; never expose plaintext credentials in argv, logs or evidence.
Preserve dmesg/syslog/SEL and command context. Do not perform the source's generic log-clear step.
Treat copied reset/MAC/IP/SEL-time/power Criteria only as invariants proving no unexpected side effect. Never manufacture a reset to satisfy that text.

Fail closed on timeout, completion error, malformed fields, path mismatch or parser ambiguity and do not retry automatically, regardless of the capability's advertised recommended-retry value for later BT traffic.
expected_evidence: DUT/host/BMC asset identity, firmware and local IPMI device plus authoritative BT interface-type proof
Pinned tool/parser/Script versions, protected OOB policy, timestamps and separate IB/OOB transport/IPMI completion records
Exact raw five data bytes from each path and decoded outstanding/input/output/time/retries fields with standard legality checks
Byte-for-byte IB/OOB parity and optional approved Project capability-profile comparison
Pre/post BMC identity/reachability, MAC/IP, SEL clock, host power and preserved-log comparison with no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On unsupported, malformed, divergent or unavailable output, preserve both path results and interface evidence, close protected sessions and escalate to the BMC/platform owner. Do not reset the BMC, change MAC/IP/time/power, clear logs, rewrite interface configuration or retry automatically. A missing BT interface is handled only through an approved SPEC-backed N/A disposition.

source_conflict.reason: The Master reset-oriented Criteria do not describe 0x36, but the Review layer now uses the authoritative five-field BT schema and retains those lines solely as no-side-effect invariants. Both source transport commands remain covered and no reset is invented.

blocked.reason: Command, response shape and legal standard fields are complete. Exact BT device, same-BMC OOB binding and optional capability profile are ordinary runtime/Project inputs for a read-only automated query.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: DUT/host/BMC mapping; authoritative local BT-interface proof; pinned tool/parser/Script; protected same-BMC OOB credentials/cipher; optional exact capability profile; timeout and evidence policy.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER READ-ONLY CASE ONLY; NO IPMI, SSH, LOG, RESET, NETWORK, TIME, POWER OR DUT COMMAND EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 11.1 through 11.4 and 22.10, Tables 22-1/22-13 and Appendix G define BT framing/multithreading, response expiration, mandatory-if-BT App 0x36 and the exact five capability fields/ranges.

project_authority: The Project owner binds the exact host/BMC, proves which local device is BT, supplies protected OOB access and may define an exact model capability profile. These inputs cannot make a non-BT local path count as BT, waive the standard five-byte legality/parity checks, or turn unrelated reset health into the primary verdict.
